source.question: Why did P-2's oil rate drop in November 2018?

submission.summary: P-2’s oil rate drop in November 2018 was an operational choke cut, not reservoir or water breakthrough. The choke was reduced from 70% to 40% on 2018-11-07, after which oil rate per producing day fell to 512 Sm3/d and monthly oil to 14,147 Sm3, while water cut stayed near 2% and BHP rose.

findings.claim: P-2’s oil rate stepped down around 2018-11-11, with weekly mean 1,046 Sm3/d falling to 369 Sm3/d (-65%).
findings.detail: detect_events regime_change oil_rate around 2018-11-11: before_mean 1046, after_mean 368.95, relative_change -0.6474, before_from 2016-10-09, after_to 2021-01-03.

findings.claim: In monthly data the drop is seen from October to November 2018, oil rate per producing day fell from 785 Sm3/d to 512 Sm3/d (-35%) and monthly oil from 23,935 Sm3 to 14,147 Sm3.
findings.detail: production_monthly: 2018-10 oil_sm3 23935, oil_rate_per_producing_day 784.73, choke_pct 70.0, bhp_bar 203.33; 2018-11 oil_sm3 14147, oil_rate_per_producing_day 511.91, choke_pct 44.29, bhp_bar 224.39. Calculated percent changes via calculate tool.

findings.claim: Daily data shows the cause was a choke cut on 2018-11-07 from 70% to 40%, a 30 percentage-point reduction, after a 2-day shut-in.
findings.detail: production_daily P-2: 2018-11-04 choke 70.0 oil 763.61 Sm3/d bhp 204.07 bar; 2018-11-05-06 on_stream_hrs 0.0 choke 0.0 shut-in; 2018-11-07 choke 40.0 oil 441.64 bhp 227.97 bar thereafter ~425-514 Sm3/d at 40%. No production_issues flagged. Other wells P-1, P-3, I-1, I-2 remained on stream in Nov 2018, so not field-wide.

findings.claim: Water cut stayed low around the drop, near 2%, so water breakthrough did not cause it.
findings.detail: production_monthly water_cut 2018-10 0.01749, 2018-11 0.01911; waterflood monthly water_cut 2018-10 0.01749, 2018-11 0.01911, wor 0.0178 to 0.01948, liquid_rate 798.7 to 521.88 Sm3/d at choke 40.0; threshold water_cut 0.05 not crossed until 2019-07-22. Field voidage replacement near 1 in 2018 (1.33) shows injection kept pace.

findings.claim: BHP rose after the choke cut, indicating restricted flow rather than depletion.
findings.detail: production_daily bhp 2018-11-02 203.44 bar, 2018-11-07 227.97 bar; monthly bhp 2018-10 203.33 bar to 2018-11 224.39 bar. Production_issues shows no gauge failure for P-2 2018-10 to 2019-02.

result.summary: Shut in for 14 days from 2019-06-03. Oil rate 414 -> 405 Sm3/d (-2%) after restart. Same time as P-1, P-3, P-4.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.05 on 2019-07-22, 53 months after first oil.

result.no_trend: too few months with WOR >= 1 (water cut 0.5) to fit a trend: 0, need 12
result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.

issues.text: downhole pressure gauge reads 0 (997 days, 261,474 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data)
oil rate stepped down 31%, weekly mean 1,304 -> 898 Sm3/d

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

arguments.sql: SELECT date, well, issue, raw_value, action FROM production_issues WHERE well='P-2' AND date BETWEEN '2018-10-01' AND '2019-02-28' ORDER BY date
SELECT date, well, on_stream_hrs, oil_sm3, water_sm3, bhp_bar, whp_bar, choke_pct FROM production_daily WHERE well='P-2' AND date BETWEEN '2018-11-01' AND '2018-12-15' ORDER BY date
SELECT date, well, on_stream_hrs, oil_sm3, choke_pct FROM production_daily WHERE date BETWEEN '2018-11-01' AND '2018-11-30' ORDER BY well, date
